final_text: Today, we are very excited to release Cosmo3. This is the strongest and the most versatile model we have ever built so far. Last year, we released Cosmo Predict for future prediction, Cosmo Transfer for domain transfer, Cosmo Reason for physical understanding, and Cosmo Policy for action generation. In Cosmo3, we bring all of them together in a single model. The latest Cosmo3.Model is an Omni model, Omni in language, video, sound and action, both inputs and outputs. It's based on a novel architecture called Mixture of Transformers, where you have two towers, the left tower run auto-regressive, the right tower run diffusion.
